messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Runbook: ink lanes and gate clearance for MAP close

Elaine —

Following up from our workshop last week, attached is the updated mutual action plan (Aurelia_MAP_v3.pdf) and a lightweight approval matrix (approval_matrix.xlsx). I put together a concise runbook to get us from final evaluation sign-off to go/no-go and the first production start date. High-level asks and proposed timing below:  

- Final exec sign-off window: Tue 2027-10-12 (we need Aurelia exec approval and Redwood legal OK)
- DocuSign routing: single envelope, sequential signers (Aurelia legal -> Aurelia CFO -> Redwood sales -> Redwood finance). Aim to e-sign 10/12 afternoon PT.
- Start date (canary): Mon 2027-10-18 (1-week limited traffic, 2 weeks for full ramp)
- Pre-sign checks: SOC2 evidence attached, IP/data flow summary (already sent), and a final latency benchmark run (we'll deliver results by 10/11 EOD).

Attachments: Aurelia_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP with milestones), approval_matrix.xlsx (roles + max approval SLA).

If that aligns, can you confirm: (1) who will be the legal signer at Aurelia, (2) whether procurement needs separate routing, and (3) any blackout dates in the week of 10/12?

I'll coordinate the DocuSign envelope and drop a HubSpot activity once you confirm signers.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
—
Redwood Inference | developer-first inference runtime
From: Elaine Park <elaine@aurelia-retail.com>

Jordan —

Thanks for this, the MAP looks good and the timing mostly works. Quick answers:  

1) Legal signer: I will be the primary, but procurement (copied) needs to countersign for terms + PO. Our CFO (Rachel K.) will be the final internal signer — I can provide her availability.
2) Procurement routing: yes — procurement needs to review T&Cs. They prefer to be in the DocuSign flow before CFO if possible.
3) Blackout dates: CFO is out 10/13-10/14; prefer to avoid major approvals on those dates.

Proposed adjustment: route DocuSign as: Aurelia Legal (Me) -> Procurement (procure@aurelia-retail.com) -> CFO (Rachel K.) -> Redwood Sales (Jordan) -> Redwood Finance (Kimberly). If that works on your side we can target afternoon 10/12 for the envelope send so Rachel can sign before end of day 10/12 PT.

Elaine Park
VP, Technology & Partnerships
Aurelia Retail

All — quick operational notes from Finance/Legal side:  

- E-sign flow: sequential routing as Elaine suggested is fine. Redwood legal has pre-approved the final SOW language; counsel sign-off is not required on our end given the SOW exhibits already redlined (so long as Aurelia accepts current exhibit language).
- Billing: Redwood finance needs the PO number before we finalize the invoice template. If procurement can include a PO in the envelope comments or we receive the PO by 10/12 EOD we can generate the first invoice dated 10/18.
- SLA exception: Aurelia requested a 99.9% latency SLO for initial ramp. That needs one manual exception sign-off from Redwood ops (I will loop ops if Aurelia agrees).

Action items assigned:
- Jordan: create DocuSign envelope, set signer order per Elaine; send draft to me for final billing fields (by 10/12 morning).
- Elaine/Procurement: provide PO or confirm PO ETA (by 10/12 EOD).
- Neha: schedule the 30-minute latency benchmark on 10/11 and paste results to the runbook.

Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations (Finance Liaisons)

To: Elaine Park <elaine@aurelia-retail.com>, Procurement <procure@aurelia-retail.com>

Subject: Re: Runbook: ink lanes and gate clearance for MAP close

Elaine / Procurement —

Thank you — updates and final plan below (please skim, action checklist at the end).

Summary of changes from the original runbook:
- DocuSign routing updated: Aurelia Legal (Elaine) -> Procurement -> CFO (Rachel K.) -> Jordan (Redwood Sales) -> Kimberly (Redwood Finance).
- Envelope send: scheduled for 2027-10-12 14:00 PT (target). I will send a HubSpot activity and the DocuSign link once sent.
- Pre-sign checks: 10/11 benchmark (Neha), PO requested by 10/12 EOD.
- Canary start: 2027-10-18 (will be gated on signed SOW + PO + successful benchmark).

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/FAKE-DOC-12345
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/56789

Action checklist (final):
1) Elaine: sign as Aurelia Legal at envelope arrival (10/12 afternoon).
2) Procurement: review & countersign; provide PO or PO number in envelope comments (10/12 EOD).
3) Rachel (CFO): sign as final Aurelia approver; avoid 10/13-10/14 per noted blackout.
4) Jordan: sign as Redwood sales and confirm invoice template with Kimberly once PO is received.
5) Kimberly: confirm first invoice generation and trigger finance hold release after PO is present.
6) Neha: paste latency benchmark results to the runbook (due 10/11 EOD).

If we get all items completed by EOD 10/12, we mark the final gate as GREEN and proceed with canary on 10/18. If any required item is missing (PO or signed SOW), we will DEFAULT to HOLD and push canary by one week to 10/25.

I'll send the envelope at 14:00 PT assuming no objections.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
